272	def _validate_one(
273	    connection_type: str, raw: dict[str, Any]
274	) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
275	    """One suggestion through the same gate a human's `create_check` reaches.
276	    Returns (accepted suggestion, None) or (None, rejection reason).
277	    """
278	    expectation_type = raw.get("expectation_type")
279	    config = raw.get("config")
280	    if (
281	        not isinstance(expectation_type, str)
282	        or expectation_type not in SUGGESTIBLE_EXPECTATION_TYPES
283	    ):
284	        return None, f"expectation_type {expectation_type!r} is not in the offered vocabulary"
285	    if not isinstance(config, dict):
286	        return None, "config must be an object"
287	    try:
288	        check_service.validate_expectation_check(expectation_type, config)
289	        check_service.reject_dataframe_only_expectation(
290	            expectation_type, connection_type=connection_type
291	        )
292	    except check_service.CheckConfigInvalidError as exc:
293	        return None, exc.message
294	    dimension = check_dimension.derive_dimension(
295	        expectation_type=expectation_type, kind="expectation"
296	    )
297	    return {
298	        "expectation_type": expectation_type,
299	        "name": str(raw.get("name") or expectation_type)[:200],
300	        "rationale": str(raw.get("rationale") or "")[:500],
301	        "config": config,
302	        "dimension": dimension,
303	    }, None

306	def validate_output(
307	    session: Session, invocation: LlmInvocation, payload: dict[str, Any]
308	) -> dict[str, Any]:
309	    """Every suggestion rides `validate_expectation_check` before it is ever
310	    stored — an invalid one is dropped, not stored; a suggestion run that
311	    suggests nothing runnable is a hard failure, not an empty success.
312	    """
313	    suite = session.get(Suite, invocation.suite_id) if invocation.suite_id else None
314	    connection = session.get(Connection, suite.connection_id) if suite is not None else None
315	    connection_type = connection.type if connection is not None else ""
316	    raw_suggestions = payload.get("suggestions")
317	    if not isinstance(raw_suggestions, list):
318	        raise LLMOutputInvalidError("provider did not return a suggestions list")
319	    accepted: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
320	    rejected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
321	    for raw in raw_suggestions[:MAX_SUGGESTIONS]:
322	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
323	            rejected.append({"expectation_type": None, "reason": "suggestion was not an object"})
324	            continue
325	        ok, reason = _validate_one(connection_type, raw)
326	        if ok is not None:
327	            accepted.append(ok)
328	        else:
329	            rejected.append({"expectation_type": raw.get("expectation_type"), "reason": reason})
330	    if not accepted:
331	        raise LLMOutputInvalidError("no suggested check passed validation")
332	    return {"suggestions": accepted, "rejected": rejected}

137	    if connection.type == "unity_catalog" and not str(target.get("catalog") or "").strip():
138	        raise LLMRequestInvalidError("a Unity Catalog target requires a catalog")

141	def _profile_prompt(
142	    session: Session,
143	    suite: Suite,
144	    connection: Connection,
145	    *,
146	    secret_store: SecretStore,
147	    actor: uuid.UUID | None,
148	) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
149	    """Column names + masked profile stats. Refuses (rather than degrades) on
150	    failure: a suggestion grounded in nothing is a confident wrong answer —
151	    unlike #1512, the profile here is never optional, so no degrade path.
152	    """
153	    columns = llm_prompt_context.list_columns_for_prompt(
154	        session,
155	        suite,
156	        connection,
157	        secret_store=secret_store,
158	        actor=actor,
159	        consumer="llm_check_suggestion",
160	    )
161	    profile = llm_prompt_context.masked_profile_for_prompt(
162	        session,
163	        suite,
164	        connection,
165	        columns,
166	        top_n=_TOP_N,
167	        secret_store=secret_store,
168	        actor=actor,
169	        consumer="llm_check_suggestion",
170	    )
171	    lines = [f"Row count: {profile.row_count}"]
172	    for col in profile.columns:
173	        stats = [f"nulls={col.null_fraction:.1%}"]
174	        if col.distinct_count is not None:
175	            stats.append(f"distinct={col.distinct_count}")
176	        if col.min_value is not None or col.max_value is not None:
177	            stats.append(f"range=[{col.min_value}, {col.max_value}]")
178	        if col.top_values:
179	            top = ", ".join(f"{t.get('value')!r} x{t.get('count')}" for t in col.top_values)
180	            stats.append(f"top_values=[{top}]")
181	        lines.append(f"- {col.column}: {' '.join(stats)}")
182	    return "\n".join(lines), columns

185	def build_prompt(
186	    session: Session, invocation: LlmInvocation, secret_store: SecretStore
187	) -> tuple[str, str | None, dict[str, Any]]:
188	    suite = session.get(Suite, invocation.suite_id) if invocation.suite_id else None
189	    if suite is None:
190	        raise LLMRequestInvalidError("the suite this suggestion run was scoped to no longer exists")
191	    connection = session.get(Connection, suite.connection_id)
192	    check_generation_preconditions(suite, connection)
193	    assert connection is not None  # preconditions refused None  # nosec B101
194	    actor = invocation.requested_by_user_id
195	    profile_text, columns = _profile_prompt(
196	        session, suite, connection, secret_store=secret_store, actor=actor
197	    )
198	    target = suite.target or {}
199	    qualified = ".".join(
200	        p for p in (target.get("catalog"), target.get("schema"), target.get("table")) if p
201	    )
202	    prompt = f"Table: {qualified}\nColumns: {', '.join(columns)}\n\nProfile:\n{profile_text}"
203	    return prompt, _SYSTEM, CHECKSUGGEST_SCHEMA

206	def _validate_one(
207	    connection_type: str, raw: dict[str, Any]
208	) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
209	    """One suggestion through the same gate a human's `create_check` reaches.
210	    Returns (accepted suggestion, None) or (None, rejection reason).
211	    """
212	    expectation_type = raw.get("expectation_type")
213	    config = raw.get("config")
214	    if (
215	        not isinstance(expectation_type, str)
216	        or expectation_type not in SUGGESTIBLE_EXPECTATION_TYPES
217	    ):
218	        return None, f"expectation_type {expectation_type!r} is not in the offered vocabulary"
219	    if not isinstance(config, dict):
220	        return None, "config must be an object"
221	    try:
222	        check_service.validate_expectation_check(expectation_type, config)
223	        check_service.reject_dataframe_only_expectation(
224	            expectation_type, connection_type=connection_type
225	        )
226	    except check_service.CheckConfigInvalidError as exc:
227	        return None, exc.message
228	    dimension = check_dimension.derive_dimension(
229	        expectation_type=expectation_type, kind="expectation"
230	    )
231	    return {
232	        "expectation_type": expectation_type,
233	        "name": str(raw.get("name") or expectation_type)[:200],
234	        "rationale": str(raw.get("rationale") or "")[:500],
235	        "config": config,
236	        "dimension": dimension,
237	    }, None
238	
239	
240	def validate_output(
241	    session: Session, invocation: LlmInvocation, payload: dict[str, Any]
242	) -> dict[str, Any]:
243	    """Every suggestion rides `validate_expectation_check` before it is ever
244	    stored — an invalid one is dropped, not stored; a suggestion run that
245	    suggests nothing runnable is a hard failure, not an empty success.
246	    """
247	    suite = session.get(Suite, invocation.suite_id) if invocation.suite_id else None
248	    if suite is None:
249	        # Never fall back to a blank connection_type: reject_dataframe_only_expectation("",
250	        # ...) silently no-ops on an unknown type instead of refusing (#1719 review) — the
251	        # context vanishing is not the model's fault, same as build_prompt's own suite-gone
252	        # case, so this is request-invalid, not a validation failure of the model's output.
253	        raise LLMRequestInvalidError("the suite this suggestion run was scoped to no longer exists")
254	    connection = session.get(Connection, suite.connection_id)
255	    if connection is None:
256	        raise LLMRequestInvalidError("the suite's connection no longer exists")
257	    connection_type = connection.type
258	    raw_suggestions = payload.get("suggestions")
259	    if not isinstance(raw_suggestions, list):
260	        raise LLMOutputInvalidError("provider did not return a suggestions list")
261	    accepted: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
262	    rejected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
263	    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
264	    for raw in raw_suggestions[:MAX_SUGGESTIONS]:
265	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
266	            rejected.append({"expectation_type": None, "reason": "suggestion was not an object"})
267	            continue
268	        ok, reason = _validate_one(connection_type, raw)
269	        if ok is None:
270	            rejected.append({"expectation_type": raw.get("expectation_type"), "reason": reason})
271	            continue
272	        # The model can propose the same rule twice (a retry, or reasoning about
273	        # the same signal from two angles) — one accepted copy, not a duplicate
274	        # presented to the reviewer as two independently-validated suggestions.
275	        identity = (ok["expectation_type"], json.dumps(ok["config"], sort_keys=True, default=str))
276	        if identity in seen:
277	            rejected.append(
278	                {"expectation_type": ok["expectation_type"], "reason": "duplicate suggestion"}
279	            )
280	            continue
281	        seen.add(identity)
282	        accepted.append(ok)
283	    if not accepted:
284	        raise LLMOutputInvalidError("no suggested check passed validation")
285	    return {"suggestions": accepted, "rejected": rejected}
